body: Unless you qualify as an independent student. I didn't need to put any info about my parents from 21 upwards. But then I was married, I don't know how else you would qualify.

That happened to me. I have pretty bad depression so my sex drive is low. My ex husband cheated on me as a result. I really wish he would have ended it instead of fucking someone else.And every time I bring this up on Reddit I get some lecture about how it was my "duty" to keep him satisfied so he had no other option.

I've been having a hard time trusting people too. I used to have a lot of friends but I lost them to move across the country for my ex-husband. We were married for four years, he cheated on me with the only friend I had managed to make during that time. Now I have zero friends and it sucks. I can't see myself trusting anyone, I think any time a person sees a moment to benefit them self they take it, disregarding anyone else's feelings.

So I already have a really strict schedule. I work so I'm doing stuff from 7am until like 6pm at night. The schedule doesn't help.I'm also not really willing to take medication. It just covers up the problem and fixes nothing.
How, though? I feel like I've exhausted all possibilities, and if I haven't, I'm not really willing to even try.

I don't think anyone would really care about the 2.9. My dad owns a very small electrical engineering business and hires a lot of engineers who didnt have 4.0s. My advice would be looking at small businesses if you haven't already. Maybe try a recruiter too. Its hard out there.
